topic: loadConfiguration facade ownership and first-error order
summary: src/config/index.ts owns loadConfiguration and createStartupConfiguration; composition is first-error path→file/parse→schema→union→API→WireMock→aggregate.
details: Issue #47 / branch j1-t8/load-configuration. loadConfiguration(env) is import-time pure until called: resolveConfigPath → readConfigFile → parseConfigYaml → validateConfigMapping → resolveEndpointUrls → createStartupConfiguration. Do not reorder stages or move the facade out of index.ts without an explicit design change.

summary: createStartupConfiguration aggregate violations throw TypeError, never ConfigError.
details: Missing capability-required URLs and invalid URL grammar in the aggregate factory surface as TypeError (ConfigError may appear only as TypeError.cause for URL revalidation). ConfigError remains the typed config-path/file/parse/schema/env failure surface; do not widen aggregate failures to ConfigError.
